content: Beene nu boom bo Nyo' le

Ben etaa kɛ eyɛn kfuu keŋkoŋɛn ke baay kè Nyo' Ice nu ɛ duŋcɛ fô beene le, ɛ ge lɛ bó eteŋe beene lɛ boom bo Nyo' le! Ɛ beene nu kecɛɛy boom bo Nyo' le. Fiɛɛ fì bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo yî woŋ wvun e baa kee beene nu njefo bó baa kee tɛn wvú wvù Nyo' kɛ.

Nsáa yɛm shém, keseen nu ɛ beene nu wase boom bo Nyo' le, geenɛn beene baa kee wase no beene nu ke enu kɛ. Fì beene kee nu kɛ lɛ ɛ̀ nu ke enu seke Klistu ɛ buynɛn, ɛ́ beene enu diɛwɛ wvú le, njefo beene nu ke eyɛn wvú le no wvú nu.
Fí ɛ mum ɛ no nu lɛ, wee tfuu wvù taale fwe yî ye le nonɛn kɛŋke keecuke ɛkolɛ kew sekecii yuule no wvú yuule.
Wee tfuu wvù gee kebefɛ nu ɛ wvù ŋgoyte ɛ ɛ̀ nu nci Nyo', njefo kebefɛ nu nci ɛ wee ɛ ŋgoy.
Ben kee lo lɛ Klistu to to keecake bibefɛ bi bonyii le. Ɛ kɛ wvú wvù Klistu to kɛŋke kebefɛ kɛ.
Kɛ wee wvù nu yî Klistu le ké mɛy no gee bibefɛ kɛ. Kɛ wee wvù mɛy ɛ no gee bibefɛ ké no ɛ yɛn wase wvú le kɛnɛɛ kee wvú kɛ.
Boom bem, fo wee elɛɛ ben kɛ. Wee wvù gee fiɛɛ teytey nu kɛ wase wee wvu teytey lɛŋlɛŋ no Klistu nu wee wvu teytey.
Wee wvù mɛy ɛ no gee bibefɛ nu wee dɛwle, njefo dɛwle wvun to gee wase bibefɛ naa ɛ kɛw lo foŋkɛw. Shiee wvù Waa Nyo' to toɛ to nu keefiwsɛ dilemme di dɛwle wvun e.
Kɛ wee wvù ɛ̀ nu mboo Nyo' ké no gee kebefɛ kɛ, njefo fiɛɛ fì ɛ̀ nu Nyo' ficii nu yî ye le sekecii, ɛ kɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ wvú ebvuu egee kebefɛ kɛ, njefo wvú nu mboo Nyo'.
Fiɛɛ fì nulo ege ɛ́ beene eyɛne bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu boom bo Nyo' le bô bò ɛ̀ nu bo dɛwle le nu fin: Wee tfuu wvù nu sɛ wvú gee mwɛɛm teytey kɛnɛɛ wvù nu sɛ wvú kooŋke waa bwee, yaa nu Waa Nyo' kɛ.
Beene ekoŋenè
Saaka wvù ben to yuwɛɛ ɛ kɛw foŋkɛw nu kɛ wvun wvù lɛ, beene ekoŋenè.
Fo beene enù diɛwɛ Kɛɛn e kɛ. Wvú to nu waa Satan wvù wee kebefɛ wɛ, ke mum nɛ yu waa bwee. Ɛ wvú to yu wvú nje la? Wvú to yu njefo diew gee to nu dì befe, ɛ di waa bwee le nu di teytey.
Boom bo bwɛɛm e, fo ben ekɛŋkè ŋghaw lɛ bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo yî woŋ wvun e bane ben kɛ.
Beene kee lo lɛ beene nu ɛ buy wase can kpwe le ɛ ley yî nshii le, njefo beene kooŋke boom bo bwee wesebeene le. Wee wvù nu sɛ wvú kooŋke waa bwee bɛɛ kɛ nu can kpwe le.
Ɛ́ ɛ̀ nu naa yɛɛ wvù bane waa bwee, tu mwɛtɛn nu wee wvù yuwyi bonyii. Ɛ ben kee lo lɛ kɛ wee wvù yuwyi bonyii kɛŋke nshii wvù mɛy lo yî ye le kɛ.
Fiɛɛ fì nu ɛ duŋcɛ beene keŋkoŋɛn ke keŋkoŋɛn nu fin fì Klistu to geɛ: Wvú to nu ɛ nya nshii we kpwe nje yese beene. Beene tɛn kɛŋke keenya wesebeene nshii nje boom bo bwee wesebeene le.
Ɛ́ wee kɛŋke mwɛɛm mvu yî nshɛ le fɛn, yɛne ɛ waa bwee tane, ɛ faŋɛ yaa eyene lo fitele fiew fô wvú le, tu keŋkoŋɛn ke Nyo' le nu yî wvuwɛ wee le nɛɛ le?
Boom bem, fo beene ekoŋenè kɛ fomvu fomvu kɛnɛɛ yî njeme le kɛ. Beene ekoŋenè yî kecɛɛy e, duŋcì yî gee le.
Ɛ̀ nɛɛ lɛ fiɛɛ fì nu ke ege ɛ́ beene ekiɛɛ lɛ beene nu bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo kecɛɛy e, ebvuu ege ɛ́ beene elɛɛse mvuntelem mvusɛɛbeene fwe dvu Nyo',
naa seke la wvù mvuntelem mvusɛɛbeene mvudvu saake beene, njefo Nyo' kuuke fele mvuntelem mvusɛɛbeene, ɛ wvú kee fiɛɛ ficii.
Nsáa yɛm shém, ɛ́ mvuntelem mvusɛɛbeene nu sɛ mvú saake beene, beene saa ekɛŋke nfan mvu fwe dvu Nyo' kɛ.
Ɛ́ beene lɛke naa la ɛ̂ wvú, ɛ́ wvú enya ɛ̂ beene, njefo beene gɛɛle bonci bew gee fiɛɛ fì ye ejeè wvú.
Ɛ nci we nu wvun wvù lɛ, beene elese fitele yî Waa we wvù Jisos Klistu le, ekoŋenè kɛ no wvú gay ɛ̂ beene.
Bonyii bocii bò gɛɛle bonci bew nu yî ye le sekecii ɛ wvú nu tɛn yî bó le. Fiɛɛ fì gee ɛ beene sɛ kee lɛ beene nu yî ye le sekecii nu Keyoy ke Yuule kè wvú nu ɛ nya ɛ̂ beene.
